item.title: Scheduled hamster maintenance 01.04.2026
item.description: On April 1st (09:00 GMT) the servers may be unavailable for a bit due to maintenance of our server hamster — we’ll oil the wheel, top up the sunflower seeds, and put him back on duty in peak condition.

item.title: Discounts on Rare Aircraft and a Royal Air Force Decal for the RAF’s Birthday!
item.description: The Royal Air Force was formed on April 1st 1918, by merging the Royal Flying Corps and the Royal Naval Air Service. It became the world’s first independent air force! Its skill and technological prowess were most evident during the Battle of Britain, preventing the Luftwaffe from gaining air superiority.

item.title: IJN Yamashiro Returns with a Discount for its Anniversary!
item.description: On March 31st 1917, the battleship Yamashiro was commissioned into the Imperial Japanese Navy, seeing action during the Second World War. During the Battle of Leyte Gulf on October 25th 1944, Yamashiro engaged a large American force in a night battle in the Surigao Strait and was sunk by torpedoes.

item.title: Pages of History (April): Operation Vulcan
item.description: In Pages of History this month, you will find yourself at the center of events that took place in various theaters of war. From Austria and Iraq, Tunisia and Cambodia: participate in battles while using vehicles linked to these historic battles and get some prizes!

item.title: 40 New User-Created Camouflages in the Ninth Wave Trophy!
item.description: This is the 40th camouflage trophy that contains... 40 new camouflages created by players on War Thunder Live! As per tradition, this trophy is timed to coincide with the release of a major update. It features a wide variety of camouflages for vehicles of all nations and ranks, including Rank IX aircraft released in the Ninth Wave major update! In addition to the camouflages, you can also receive a unique decal and rare vehicles, all in the form of coupons.

item.title: Enjoy a Decal and Discounts on Three Vehicles for Italian Air Force Day!
item.description: Italy was a pioneer in aviation. Airships served its army from the mid-1880s, and on March 28th 1923, the Air Force became a separate branch of the armed forces. Renowned director Hayao Miyazaki celebrated Italian aviation in his animated films Porco Rosso and The Wind Rises, and the image of a black horse standing on its heel, depicted on the plane of Italian World War I ace Francesco Baracca, inspired the Ferrari logo.

item.title: Discounts on Two Rare Tanks for Bangladesh’s 55th Anniversary of Independence!
item.description: On March 26th 1971, Bangladesh declared its independence. It had to be defended by force, after Pakistan did not want to lose its eastern territories. Soon after India was drawn into the war in December, Pakistan capitulated. March 26th is the most important public holiday in Bangladesh, widely celebrated with parades, concerts, and various ceremonies.

item.title: War Thunder Infantry: The Second Testing Phase!
item.description: Hello there everyone! Today, we’re pleased to announce the second phase of Closed Beta Testing (CBT) for War Thunder Infantry. What can you expect? Solo gameplay with no bot squads, new missions, a new location, numerous improvements, new mechanics and weapons are ready for you. Let’s get into the details!

item.title: Get the German La-5FN as it Temporarily Returns to Mark the La-5’s First Flight!
item.description: The La-5 fighter’s maiden flight took place on March 21st 1942. Thanks to its new engine, the La-5 achieved parity with Luftwaffe aircraft at low and medium altitudes. Many Soviet aces, such as Ivan Kozhedub, flew this fighter.

item.title: The WTCS Challenger League Major I is Here: Register Now For The Qualification Stage!
item.description: Last Sunday marked the conclusion of the first Major of the year in the Pro League! An intense, high-level competition that sets the tone for what promises to be an incredible season.

item.title: Enjoy Spring Discounts on Starter Packs!
item.description: Spring is a time of sunshine, optimism, and new aspirations! Why not try your hand at a new research tree in War Thunder? Speed up your new nation’s progress with one of our starter packs, available at a great price!

item.title: Thank you for your patience: Compensation for connection issues due to DDoS attacks
item.description: Recently, DDoS attacks on the game’s infrastructure have increased. We’ve been mitigating them as quickly as we can, however some players experienced issues with authentication and joining battles. As a token of our gratitude for your patience, we are granting the compensation.

item.title: Meet the “Ninth Wave” Major Update!
item.description: The Ninth Wave major update brings a wealth of new content and improvements for everyone to enjoy. Key additions include several ground vehicles, including the Dragoon and the Second World War Ho-Ni II, as well as the AS90 for Great Britain. We’ve also added the new F-16CM PoBIT rank IX aircraft for the USA, alongside several Hungarian planes integrated into the Italian air tree. Naval enjoyers can acquire the notable USS Helm as a premium ship, accompanied by stunning new water effects. In addition to new vehicles, the map rotation welcomes back White Rock Fortress, featuring its classic layout now enhanced with graphical improvements!

item.title: BTR-3E1: Eight Wheels of Fury
item.description: The BTR-3 is a Ukrainian 8×8 armored personnel carrier developed in the early 2000s in an effort to maintain domestic military production following the collapse of the USSR.

item.title: J-15T: The Flying Shark
item.description: China’s new top tier aircraft is the J-15T carrier-based multirole jet fighter with long-range PL-12A missiles and a huge arsenal of guided weapons!

item.title: A Decal Trophy and Discount on LÉ Orla for St. Patrick’s Day!
item.description: The main holiday of Irish culture and the memory of Ireland’s patron saint, St. Patrick, is celebrated on March 17th. Originally a missionary’s day of remembrance, it became widely recognized as a secular holiday at the end of the second millennium. It is celebrated worldwide, one example of this is the river in Chicago that has been dyed green on St. Patrick’s Day since 1962!

item.title: The M728 CEV is Available at a Discounted Price for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Anniversary!
item.description: The Corps of Engineers was established in the American Army in 1775, but was disbanded shortly after the end of the Revolutionary War. The Act for the Peaceful Organization of the Army, signed on March 16th 1802, established the Corps of Engineers as a permanent, separate branch of the armed forces. The Corps of Engineers designs, builds, and maintains canals, dams, ports, and locks, helps protect the environment, and responds to natural disasters.

item.title: Ninth Wave: New Water and Naval Battle Effects
item.description: In the Ninth Wave major update, we’ll be adding completely reworked water and updated effects for naval battles!
